1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 80 cm de longitud, con aletas radiadas, de color gris plateado; es comestible, aunque no muy apreciado. (Haemulidae; Haemulon album).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 80 cm in length, with radiated fins and a silvery grey color; it is edible, although not highly prized (family Haemulidae; species Haemulon album).
